description: Architectural DXF reverse engineering: 3D concrete frame
message: Extract the structural grid and beam connectivity from the attached architectural floor-plan DXF and engineering specification, filter out non-structural building elements, build the spatial calculation model, and run static analysis. Use visible plan dimensions and topology; do not infer missing engineering information.
engineeringSpecification: Material C30: E=30000 MPa, ν=0.2, density=2500 kg/m3, and fc=14.3 MPa. Columns use C30 500x500 sections (H=500 mm, B=500 mm; A=0.25 m2, Iy=0.0052 m4, Iz=0.0052 m4, J=0.0088021 m4, G=12500 MPa). Beams use C30 300x600 sections (H=600 mm, B=300 mm; A=0.18 m2, Iy=0.0054 m4, Iz=0.00135 m4, J=0.00370786 m4, G=12500 MPa). Map the floor plan's source X/Y axes to global X/Y; create two stories in global Z, each 3.6 m high. Use fixed column bases and apply global-Z downward floor loads of 12 kN/m2 on the first story and 10 kN/m2 on the second story. Use SI units and the global-Z-up coordinate convention, do not add member self-weight, and analyze load combination ULS = 1 × D.
